items.t: Glibenclamide, oral, 2.5 mg daily 30 minutes before breakfast.
Glibenclamide, oral, 2.5 mg daily 30 minutes with breakfast. · Titrate dose slowly depending on HbA1c and/or fasting blood glucose levels to a maximum of 15 mg daily.

contraindications.t: Type 1 diabetes, ketoacidosis, severe renal or hepatic impairment, elderly (long-acting), porphyria

cautions.t: Hypoglycaemia may recur for 24–72 h after overdose – admit
Avoid in the elderly and in renal impairment
